cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: I'm going to report on a case study of a programme which has been set up to help rural

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: populations in Mozambique, a largely agricultural country in South-East Africa.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The programme worked with three communities in Chicualacuala district, near the Limpopo

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: River. This is a dry and arid region, with unpredictable rainfall.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: Because of this, people in the area were unable to support themselves through agriculture

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: and instead they used the forest as a means of providing themselves with an income,

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: mainly by selling charcoal.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: However, this was not a sustainable way of living in the long term, as they were rapidly

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: using up this resource.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: To support agriculture in this dry region, the programme focused primarily on making use

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: of existing water resources from the Limpopo River by setting up systems of irrigation,

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: which would provide a dependable water supply for crops and animals.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The programme worked closely with the district government in order to find the best way

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: of implementing this.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The region already had one farmers' association, and it was decided to set up two more of

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: these.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: These associations planned and carried out activities including water management,

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: livestock breeding and agriculture, and it was notable that in general, women formed the

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: majority of the workforce.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: It was decided that in order to keep the crops safe from animals, both wild and domestic,

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: special areas should be fenced off where the crops could be grown.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The community was responsible for creating these fences, but the programme provided the

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: necessary wire for making them.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: Once the area had been fenced off, it could be cultivated.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The land was dug, so that vegetables and cereals appropriate to the climate could be

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: grown, and the programme provided the necessary seeds for this.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: The programme also provided pumps so that water could be brought from the river in pipes

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: to the fields.

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: However, the labour was all provided by local people, and they also provided and put up

cues.speaker: AM
cues.text: the posts that supported the fences around the fields.
